description: She wears an opaque deep rust-burgundy floor-length gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and full skirt. Rich gold-toned stitched geometric borders and fine motifs decorate the bodice, shoulder bands, cuffs, vertical front and hem. A cream patterned underdress shows through a modest opening below the knee. A gold-beige draped wrap with burgundy geometric borders and fringed ends rests across her forearms. An ornate belt has a round central clasp and hanging fittings. Gold-toned drop earrings, a decorated pendant necklace, bracelet and several finger rings are visible. Brown shoe toes carry gold-toned pattern decoration. No headgear or weapon is visible.
